payload.description:
## Context
When a lane lands with basicly worktree merge, I want the destination verified without a local full suite on main, so I can land lanes in parallel and follow the rule that full verification runs in CI.
Evidence 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13: after each plain landing (.43.28, .43.37, basicly-f2zwd26) the next landing refused with destination is unverified after <id>; run basicly verify --mode full --issue <id>. Each local run took about 7 to 9 minutes (8 min 5 s wall on 5d26e2d5, pytest 418.63 s, 8961 passed). AGENTS.md says Full verification runs in CI only. Do not run the full suite locally on routine edits or integration; the landing guard (src/basicly/landing_guard.py blocker) demands the local run, so the two rules contradict for a landing. Only the loop path records a post-merge verification (loop.py record_post_merge_verification). Decided by the orchestrator 2026-11-13. Build after the vault cutover (.43.34). Neither rule is weakened until then.
